xMax.description: The reactance depends on the tap position according to a "u" shaped curve. The maximum reactance (xMax) appears at the low and high tap positions. Depending on the “u” curve the attribute can be either higher or lower than PowerTransformerEnd.x. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

xMin.name: xMin
xMin.description: The reactance depend on the tap position according to a "u" shaped curve. The minimum reactance (xMin) appear at the mid tap position. PowerTransformerEnd.x shall be consistent with PhaseTapChangerLinear.xMin and PhaseTapChangerNonLinear.xMin. In case of inconsistency, PowerTransformerEnd.x shall be used. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

PhaseTapChangerSymmetrical.description: Describes a symmetrical phase shifting transformer tap model in which the voltage magnitude of both sides is the same. The difference voltage magnitude is the base in an equal-sided triangle where the sides corresponds to the primary and secondary voltages. The phase angle difference corresponds to the top angle and can be expressed as twice the arctangent of half the total difference voltage.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PhaseTapChangerSymmetrical: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

PhaseTapChangerTable.description: Describes a tabular curve for how the phase angle difference and impedance varies with the tap step.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PhaseTapChangerTable: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

PhaseTapChangerTablePoint.description: Describes each tap step in the phase tap changer tabular curve.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PhaseTapChangerTablePoint: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

angle.name: angle
angle.description: The angle difference in degrees. A positive value indicates a positive angle variation from the Terminal at the PowerTransformerEnd, where the TapChanger is located, into the transformer. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type AngleDegrees, in deg.

PhaseTapChangerTabular.description: Describes a tap changer with a table defining the relation between the tap step and the phase angle difference across the transformer.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PhaseTapChangerTabular: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

PhotoVoltaicUnit.description: A photovoltaic device or an aggregation of such devices.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PhotoVoltaicUnit: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

PostLineSensor.description: A sensor used mainly in overhead distribution networks as the source of both current and voltage measurements.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PostLineSensor: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

PotentialTransformer.description: Instrument transformer (also known as Voltage Transformer) used to measure electrical qualities of the circuit that is being protected and/or monitored. Typically used as voltage transducer for the purpose of metering, protection, or sometimes auxiliary substation supply. A typical secondary voltage rating would be 120V.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PotentialTransformer: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

PowerElectronicsConnection.description: A connection to the AC network for energy production or consumption that uses power electronics rather than rotating machines.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PowerElectronicsConnection: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

maxQ.name: maxQ
maxQ.description: Maximum reactive power limit. This is the maximum (nameplate) limit for the unit. CIM type ReactivePower, in MVAr.

minQ.name: minQ
minQ.description: Minimum reactive power limit for the unit. This is the minimum (nameplate) limit for the unit. CIM type ReactivePower, in MVAr.

p.name: p
p.description: Active power injection. Load sign convention is used, i.e. positive sign means flow out from a node. Starting value for a steady state solution. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type ActivePower, in MW.

q.name: q
q.description: Reactive power injection. Load sign convention is used, i.e. positive sign means flow out from a node. Starting value for a steady state solution. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type ReactivePower, in MVAr.

ratedS.name: ratedS
ratedS.description: Nameplate apparent power rating for the unit. The attribute shall have a positive value. CIM type ApparentPower, in MVA.

ratedU.name: ratedU
ratedU.description: Rated voltage (nameplate data, Ur in IEC 60909-0). It is primarily used for short circuit data exchange according to IEC 60909. The attribute shall be a positive value. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

PowerElectronicsUnit.description: A generating unit or battery or aggregation that connects to the AC network using power electronics rather than rotating machines.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PowerElectronicsUnit: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

maxP.name: maxP
maxP.description: Maximum active power limit. This is the maximum (nameplate) limit for the unit. CIM type ActivePower, in MW.

minP.name: minP
minP.description: Minimum active power limit. This is the minimum (nameplate) limit for the unit. CIM type ActivePower, in MW.

PowerElectronicsWindUnit.description: A wind generating unit that connects to the AC network with power electronics rather than rotating machines or an aggregation of such units.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PowerElectronicsWindUnit: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

PowerSystemResource.description: A power system resource (PSR) can be an item of equipment such as a switch, an equipment container containing many individual items of equipment such as a substation, or an organisational entity such as sub-control area. Power system resources can have measurements associated.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PowerSystemResource: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

PowerTransformer.description: An electrical device consisting of two or more coupled windings, with or without a magnetic core, for introducing mutual coupling between electric circuits. Transformers can be used to control voltage and phase shift (active power flow). A power transformer may be composed of separate transformer tanks that need not be identical. A power transformer can be modelled with or without tanks and is intended for use in both balanced and unbalanced representations. A power transformer typically has two terminals, but may have one (grounding), three or more terminals. The inherited association ConductingEquipment.BaseVoltage should not be used. The association from TransformerEnd to BaseVoltage should be used instead.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PowerTransformer: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

beforeShCircuitHighestOperatingCurrent.name: beforeShCircuitHighestOperatingCurrent
beforeShCircuitHighestOperatingCurrent.description: The highest operating current (Ib in IEC 60909-0) before short circuit (depends on network configuration and relevant reliability philosophy). It is used for calculation of the impedance correction factor KT defined in IEC 60909-0. CIM type CurrentFlow, in A.

beforeShCircuitHighestOperatingVoltage.name: beforeShCircuitHighestOperatingVoltage
beforeShCircuitHighestOperatingVoltage.description: The highest operating voltage (Ub in IEC 60909-0) before short circuit. It is used for calculation of the impedance correction factor KT defined in IEC 60909-0. This is worst case voltage on the low side winding (3.7.1 of IEC 60909:2001). Used to define operating conditions. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

beforeShortCircuitAnglePf.name: beforeShortCircuitAnglePf
beforeShortCircuitAnglePf.description: The angle of power factor before short circuit (phib in IEC 60909-0). It is used for calculation of the impedance correction factor KT defined in IEC 60909-0. This is the worst case power factor. Used to define operating conditions. CIM type AngleDegrees, in deg.

highSideMinOperatingU.name: highSideMinOperatingU
highSideMinOperatingU.description: The minimum operating voltage (uQmin in IEC 60909-0) at the high voltage side (Q side) of the unit transformer of the power station unit. A value well established from long-term operating experience of the system. It is used for calculation of the impedance correction factor KG defined in IEC 60909-0. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

isPartOfGeneratorUnit.name: isPartOfGeneratorUnit
isPartOfGeneratorUnit.description: Indicates whether the machine is part of a power station unit. Used for short circuit data exchange according to IEC 60909. It has an impact on how the correction factors are calculated for transformers, since the transformer is not necessarily part of a synchronous machine and generating unit. It is not always possible to derive this information from the model. This is why the attribute is necessary. Multiplicity 1..1.

operationalValuesConsidered.name: operationalValuesConsidered
operationalValuesConsidered.description: It is used to define if the data (other attributes related to short circuit data exchange) defines long term operational conditions or not. Used for short circuit data exchange according to IEC 60909.

PowerTransformerEnd.description: A PowerTransformerEnd is associated with each Terminal of a PowerTransformer. The impedance values r, r0, x, and x0 of a PowerTransformerEnd represents a star equivalent as follows. 1) for a two Terminal PowerTransformer the high voltage (TransformerEnd.endNumber=1) PowerTransformerEnd has non zero values on r, r0, x, and x0 while the low voltage (TransformerEnd.endNumber=2) PowerTransformerEnd has zero values for r, r0, x, and x0. Parameters are always provided, even if the PowerTransformerEnds have the same rated voltage. In this case, the parameters are provided at the PowerTransformerEnd which has TransformerEnd.endNumber equal to 1. 2) for a three Terminal PowerTransformer the three PowerTransformerEnds represent a star equivalent with each leg in the star represented by r, r0, x, and x0 values. 3) For a three Terminal transformer each PowerTransformerEnd shall have g, g0, b and b0 values corresponding to the no load losses distributed on the three PowerTransformerEnds. The total no load loss shunt…

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the PowerTransformerEnd: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

b.name: b
b.description: Magnetizing branch susceptance (B mag). The value can be positive or negative. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Susceptance, in S.

b0.name: b0
b0.description: Zero sequence magnetizing branch susceptance. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Susceptance, in S.

g.name: g
g.description: Magnetizing branch conductance. CIM type Conductance, in S.

g0.name: g0
g0.description: Zero sequence magnetizing branch conductance (star-model). Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Conductance, in S.

phaseAngleClock.name: phaseAngleClock
phaseAngleClock.description: Terminal voltage phase angle displacement where 360 degrees are represented with clock hours. The valid values are 0 to 11. For example, for the secondary side end of a transformer with vector group code of 'Dyn11', specify the connection kind as wye with neutral and specify the phase angle of the clock as 11. The clock value of the transformer end number specified as 1, is assumed to be zero. Note the transformer end number is not assumed to be the same as the terminal sequence number. Multiplicity 1..1.

r.name: r
r.description: Resistance (star-model) of the transformer end. The attribute shall be equal to or greater than zero for non-equivalent transformers. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Resistance, in ohm.

r0.name: r0
r0.description: Zero sequence series resistance (star-model) of the transformer end. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Resistance, in ohm.

ratedS.name: ratedS
ratedS.description: Normal apparent power rating. The attribute shall be a positive value. For a two-winding transformer the values for the high and low voltage sides shall be identical. CIM type ApparentPower, in MVA.

ratedU.name: ratedU
ratedU.description: Rated voltage: phase-phase for three-phase windings, and either phase-phase or phase-neutral for single-phase windings. A high voltage side, as given by TransformerEnd.endNumber, shall have a ratedU that is greater than or equal to ratedU for the lower voltage sides. The attribute shall be a positive value. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

x.name: x
x.description: Positive sequence series reactance (star-model) of the transformer end. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

x0.name: x0
x0.description: Zero sequence series reactance of the transformer end. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

ProtectedSwitch.description: A ProtectedSwitch is a switching device that can be operated by ProtectionEquipment.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the ProtectedSwitch: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

RatioTapChanger.description: A tap changer that changes the voltage ratio impacting the voltage magnitude but not the phase angle across the transformer. Angle sign convention (general): Positive value indicates a positive phase shift from the winding where the tap is located to the other winding (for a two-winding transformer).

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the RatioTapChanger: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

stepVoltageIncrement.name: stepVoltageIncrement
stepVoltageIncrement.description: Tap step increment, in per cent of rated voltage of the power transformer end, per step position. When the increment is negative, the voltage decreases when the tap step increases. Multiplicity 1..1.

RatioTapChangerTable.description: Describes a curve for how the voltage magnitude and impedance varies with the tap step.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the RatioTapChangerTable: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

RatioTapChangerTablePoint.description: Describes each tap step in the ratio tap changer tabular curve.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the RatioTapChangerTablePoint: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

ReactiveCapabilityCurve.description: Reactive power rating envelope versus the synchronous machine's active power, in both the generating and motoring modes. For each active power value there is a corresponding high and low reactive power limit value. Typically there will be a separate curve for each coolant condition, such as hydrogen pressure. The Y1 axis values represent reactive minimum and the Y2 axis values represent reactive maximum.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the ReactiveCapabilityCurve: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

RegulatingCondEq.description: A type of conducting equipment that can regulate a quantity (i.e. voltage or flow) at a specific point in the network.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the RegulatingCondEq: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

controlEnabled.name: controlEnabled
controlEnabled.description: Specifies the regulation status of the equipment. True is regulating, false is not regulating. Multiplicity 1..1.

RegulatingControl.description: Specifies a set of equipment that works together to control a power system quantity such as voltage or flow. Remote bus voltage control is possible by specifying the controlled terminal located at some place remote from the controlling equipment. The specified terminal shall be associated with the connectivity node of the controlled point. The most specific subtype of RegulatingControl shall be used in case such equipment participate in the control, e.g. TapChangerControl for tap changers. For flow control, load sign convention is used, i.e. positive sign means flow out from a TopologicalNode (bus) into the conducting equipment. The attribute minAllowedTargetValue and maxAllowedTargetValue are required in the following cases: - For a power generating module operated in power factor control mode to specify maximum and minimum power factor values; - Whenever it is necessary to have an off center target voltage for the tap changer regulator. For instance, due to long cables to off shore wind farms and the need…

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the RegulatingControl: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

discrete.name: discrete
discrete.description: The regulation is performed in a discrete mode. This applies to equipment with discrete controls, e.g. tap changers and shunt compensators. Multiplicity 1..1.

enabled.name: enabled
enabled.description: The flag tells if regulation is enabled. Multiplicity 1..1.

mode.name: mode
mode.description: The regulating control mode presently available. This specification allows for determining the kind of regulation without need for obtaining the units from a schedule. Multiplicity 1..1.

targetDeadband.name: targetDeadband
targetDeadband.description: This is a deadband used with discrete control to avoid excessive update of controls like tap changers and shunt compensator banks while regulating. The units of those appropriate for the mode. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero. If RegulatingControl.discrete is set to "false", the RegulatingControl.targetDeadband is to be ignored. Note that for instance, if the targetValue is 100 kV and the targetDeadband is 2 kV the range is from 99 to 101 kV.

targetValue.name: targetValue
targetValue.description: The target value specified for case input. This value can be used for the target value without the use of schedules. The value has the units appropriate to the mode attribute. Multiplicity 1..1.

targetValueUnitMultiplier.name: targetValueUnitMultiplier
targetValueUnitMultiplier.description: Specify the multiplier for used for the targetValue. Multiplicity 1..1.

RegularTimePoint.description: Time point for a schedule where the time between the consecutive points is constant.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the RegularTimePoint: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

sequenceNumber.name: sequenceNumber
sequenceNumber.description: The position of the regular time point in the sequence. Note that time points don't have to be sequential, i.e. time points may be omitted. The actual time for a RegularTimePoint is computed by multiplying the associated regular interval schedule's time step with the regular time point sequence number and adding the associated schedules start time. To specify values for the start time, use sequence number 0. The sequence number cannot be negative. Multiplicity 1..1.

value1.name: value1
value1.description: The first value at the time. The meaning of the value is defined by the derived type of the associated schedule. Multiplicity 1..1.

value2.name: value2
value2.description: The second value at the time. The meaning of the value is defined by the derived type of the associated schedule.

RegularIntervalSchedule.description: The schedule has time points where the time between them is constant.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the RegularIntervalSchedule: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

endTime.name: endTime
endTime.description: The time for the last time point. The value can be a time of day, not a specific date. Multiplicity 1..1.

timeStep.name: timeStep
timeStep.description: The time between each pair of subsequent regular time points in sequence order. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Seconds, in s.

ReportingGroup.description: A reporting group is used for various ad-hoc groupings used for reporting.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the ReportingGroup: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

RotatingMachine.description: A rotating machine which may be used as a generator or motor.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the RotatingMachine: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

p.name: p
p.description: Active power injection. Load sign convention is used, i.e. positive sign means flow out from a node. Starting value for a steady state solution. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type ActivePower, in MW.

q.name: q
q.description: Reactive power injection. Load sign convention is used, i.e. positive sign means flow out from a node. Starting value for a steady state solution. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type ReactivePower, in MVAr.

ratedPowerFactor.name: ratedPowerFactor
ratedPowerFactor.description: Power factor (nameplate data). It is primarily used for short circuit data exchange according to IEC 60909. The attribute cannot be a negative value.

ratedS.name: ratedS
ratedS.description: Nameplate apparent power rating for the unit. The attribute shall have a positive value. CIM type ApparentPower, in MVA.

ratedU.name: ratedU
ratedU.description: Rated voltage (nameplate data, Ur in IEC 60909-0). It is primarily used for short circuit data exchange according to IEC 60909. The attribute shall be a positive value. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

Season.description: A specified time period of the year.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Season: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

Sensor.description: This class describe devices that transform a measured quantity into signals that can be presented at displays, used in control or be recorded.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Sensor: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

SeasonDayTypeSchedule.description: A time schedule covering a 24 hour period, with curve data for a specific type of season and day.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the SeasonDayTypeSchedule: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

SeriesCompensator.description: A Series Compensator is a series capacitor or reactor or an AC transmission line without charging susceptance. It is a two terminal device.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the SeriesCompensator: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

r.name: r
r.description: Positive sequence resistance. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Resistance, in ohm.

r0.name: r0
r0.description: Zero sequence resistance. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Resistance, in ohm.

varistorPresent.name: varistorPresent
varistorPresent.description: Describe if a metal oxide varistor (mov) for over voltage protection is configured in parallel with the series compensator. It is used for short circuit calculations. Multiplicity 1..1.

varistorRatedCurrent.name: varistorRatedCurrent
varistorRatedCurrent.description: The maximum current the varistor is designed to handle at specified duration. It is used for short circuit calculations and exchanged only if SeriesCompensator.varistorPresent is true. The attribute shall be a positive value. CIM type CurrentFlow, in A.

varistorVoltageThreshold.name: varistorVoltageThreshold
varistorVoltageThreshold.description: The dc voltage at which the varistor starts conducting. It is used for short circuit calculations and exchanged only if SeriesCompensator.varistorPresent is true. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

x.name: x
x.description: Positive sequence reactance. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

x0.name: x0
x0.description: Zero sequence reactance. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

ShuntCompensator.description: A shunt capacitor or reactor or switchable bank of shunt capacitors or reactors. A section of a shunt compensator is an individual capacitor or reactor. A negative value for bPerSection indicates that the compensator is a reactor. ShuntCompensator is a single terminal device. Ground is implied.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the ShuntCompensator: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

aVRDelay.name: aVRDelay
aVRDelay.description: An automatic voltage regulation delay (AVRDelay) which is the time delay from a change in voltage to when the capacitor is allowed to change state. This filters out temporary changes in voltage. CIM type Seconds, in s.

grounded.name: grounded
grounded.description: Used for Yn and Zn connections. True if the neutral is solidly grounded.

maximumSections.name: maximumSections
maximumSections.description: The maximum number of sections that may be switched in. Multiplicity 1..1.

nomU.name: nomU
nomU.description: The voltage at which the nominal reactive power may be calculated. This should normally be within 10% of the voltage at which the capacitor is connected to the network. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

normalSections.name: normalSections
normalSections.description: The normal number of sections switched in. The value shall be between zero and ShuntCompensator.maximumSections. Multiplicity 1..1.

sections.name: sections
sections.description: Shunt compensator sections in use. Starting value for steady state solution. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero. Non integer values are allowed to support continuous variables. The reasons for continuous value are to support study cases where no discrete shunt compensators has yet been designed, a solutions where a narrow voltage band force the sections to oscillate or accommodate for a continuous solution as input. For LinearShuntConpensator the value shall be between zero and ShuntCompensator.maximumSections. At value zero the shunt compensator conductance and admittance is zero. Linear interpolation of conductance and admittance between the previous and next integer section is applied in case of non-integer values. For NonlinearShuntCompensator-s shall only be set to one of the NonlinearShuntCompenstorPoint.sectionNumber. There is no interpolation between NonlinearShuntCompenstorPoint-s. Multiplicity 1..1.

voltageSensitivity.name: voltageSensitivity
voltageSensitivity.description: Voltage sensitivity required for the device to regulate the bus voltage, in voltage/reactive power. CIM type VoltagePerReactivePower, in VPerVAr.

SolarGeneratingUnit.description: A solar thermal generating unit, connected to the grid by means of a rotating machine. This class does not represent photovoltaic (PV) generation.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the SolarGeneratingUnit: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the SolarPowerPlant: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

StaticVarCompensator.description: A facility for providing variable and controllable shunt reactive power. The SVC typically consists of a stepdown transformer, filter, thyristor-controlled reactor, and thyristor-switched capacitor arms. The SVC may operate in fixed MVar output mode or in voltage control mode. When in voltage control mode, the output of the SVC will be proportional to the deviation of voltage at the controlled bus from the voltage setpoint. The SVC characteristic slope defines the proportion. If the voltage at the controlled bus is equal to the voltage setpoint, the SVC MVar output is zero.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the StaticVarCompensator: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

capacitiveRating.name: capacitiveRating
capacitiveRating.description: Capacitive reactance at maximum capacitive reactive power. Shall always be positive. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

inductiveRating.name: inductiveRating
inductiveRating.description: Inductive reactance at maximum inductive reactive power. Shall always be negative. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

q.name: q
q.description: Reactive power injection. Load sign convention is used, i.e. positive sign means flow out from a node. Starting value for a steady state solution. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type ReactivePower, in MVAr.

slope.name: slope
slope.description: The characteristics slope of an SVC defines how the reactive power output changes in proportion to the difference between the regulated bus voltage and the voltage setpoint. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type VoltagePerReactivePower, in VPerVAr.

voltageSetPoint.name: voltageSetPoint
voltageSetPoint.description: The reactive power output of the SVC is proportional to the difference between the voltage at the regulated bus and the voltage setpoint. When the regulated bus voltage is equal to the voltage setpoint, the reactive power output is zero. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

StationSupply.description: Station supply with load derived from the station output.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the StationSupply: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

SubGeographicalRegion.description: A subset of a geographical region of a power system network model.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the SubGeographicalRegion: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

SubLoadArea.description: The class is the second level in a hierarchical structure for grouping of loads for the purpose of load flow load scaling.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the SubLoadArea: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

Substation.description: A collection of equipment for purposes other than generation or utilization, through which electric energy in bulk is passed for the purposes of switching or modifying its characteristics.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Substation: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

SurgeArrester.description: Shunt device, installed on the network, usually in the proximity of electrical equipment in order to protect the said equipment against transient voltage transients caused by lightning or switching activity.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the SurgeArrester: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

Switch.description: A generic device designed to close, or open, or both, one or more electric circuits. All switches are two terminal devices including grounding switches. The ACDCTerminal.connected at the two sides of the switch shall not be considered for assessing switch connectivity, i.e. only Switch.open, .normalOpen and .locked are relevant.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Switch: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

locked.name: locked
locked.description:
If true, the switch is locked. The resulting switch state is a combination of locked and Switch.open attributes as follows:
  • locked=true and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open and locked;
  • locked=false and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open;
  • locked=false and Switch.open=false. The resulting state is closed.
. Multiplicity 1..1.

normalOpen.name: normalOpen
normalOpen.description: The attribute is used in cases when no Measurement for the status value is present. If the Switch has a status measurement the Discrete.normalValue is expected to match with the Switch.normalOpen. Multiplicity 1..1.

open.name: open
open.description: The attribute tells if the switch is considered open when used as input to topology processing. Multiplicity 1..1.

ratedCurrent.name: ratedCurrent
ratedCurrent.description: The maximum continuous current carrying capacity in amps governed by the device material and construction. The attribute shall be a positive value. CIM type CurrentFlow, in A.

retained.name: retained
retained.description: Branch is retained in the topological solution. The flow through retained switches will normally be calculated in power flow. Multiplicity 1..1.

SwitchSchedule.description: A schedule of switch positions. If RegularTimePoint.value1 is 0, the switch is open. If 1, the switch is closed.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the SwitchSchedule: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

SynchronousMachine.description: An electromechanical device that operates with shaft rotating synchronously with the network. It is a single machine operating either as a generator or synchronous condenser or pump.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the SynchronousMachine: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

earthing.name: earthing
earthing.description: Indicates whether or not the generator is earthed. Used for short circuit data exchange according to IEC 60909. Multiplicity 1..1.

earthingStarPointR.name: earthingStarPointR
earthingStarPointR.description: Generator star point earthing resistance (Re). Used for short circuit data exchange according to IEC 60909. CIM type Resistance, in ohm.

earthingStarPointX.name: earthingStarPointX
earthingStarPointX.description: Generator star point earthing reactance (Xe). Used for short circuit data exchange according to IEC 60909. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

ikk.name: ikk
ikk.description: Steady-state short-circuit current (in A for the profile) of generator with compound excitation during 3-phase short circuit. - Ikk=0: Generator with no compound excitation. - Ikk<>0: Generator with compound excitation. Ikk is used to calculate the minimum steady-state short-circuit current for generators with compound excitation. (4.6.1.2 in IEC 60909-0:2001). Used only for single fed short circuit on a generator. (4.3.4.2. in IEC 60909-0:2001). CIM type CurrentFlow, in A.

maxQ.name: maxQ
maxQ.description: Maximum reactive power limit. This is the maximum (nameplate) limit for the unit. CIM type ReactivePower, in MVAr.

minQ.name: minQ
minQ.description: Minimum reactive power limit for the unit. CIM type ReactivePower, in MVAr.

mu.name: mu
mu.description: Factor to calculate the breaking current (Section 4.5.2.1 in IEC 60909-0). Used only for single fed short circuit on a generator (Section 4.3.4.2. in IEC 60909-0).

qPercent.name: qPercent
qPercent.description: Part of the coordinated reactive control that comes from this machine. The attribute is used as a participation factor not necessarily summing up to 100% for the participating devices in the control.

r.name: r
r.description: Equivalent resistance (RG) of generator. RG is considered for the calculation of all currents, except for the calculation of the peak current ip. Used for short circuit data exchange according to IEC 60909. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Resistance, in ohm.

r0.name: r0
r0.description: Zero sequence resistance of the synchronous machine. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Resistance, in ohm.

r2.name: r2
r2.description: Negative sequence resistance. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Resistance, in ohm.

referencePriority.name: referencePriority
referencePriority.description: Priority of unit for use as powerflow voltage phase angle reference bus selection. 0 = don t care (default) 1 = highest priority. 2 is less than 1 and so on. Multiplicity 1..1.

satDirectSubtransX.name: satDirectSubtransX
satDirectSubtransX.description: Direct-axis subtransient reactance saturated, also known as Xd"sat. Multiplicity 1..1.

satDirectSyncX.name: satDirectSyncX
satDirectSyncX.description: Direct-axes saturated synchronous reactance (xdsat); reciprocal of short-circuit ration. Used for short circuit data exchange, only for single fed short circuit on a generator. (4.3.4.2. in IEC 60909-0:2001).

satDirectTransX.name: satDirectTransX
satDirectTransX.description: Saturated Direct-axis transient reactance. The attribute is primarily used for short circuit calculations according to ANSI.

shortCircuitRotorType.name: shortCircuitRotorType
shortCircuitRotorType.description: Type of rotor, used by short circuit applications, only for single fed short circuit according to IEC 60909.

type.name: type
type.description: Modes that this synchronous machine can operate in. Multiplicity 1..1.

voltageRegulationRange.name: voltageRegulationRange
voltageRegulationRange.description: Range of generator voltage regulation (PG in IEC 60909-0) used for calculation of the impedance correction factor KG defined in IEC 60909-0. This attribute is used to describe the operating voltage of the generating unit.

x0.name: x0
x0.description: Zero sequence reactance of the synchronous machine. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

x2.name: x2
x2.description: Negative sequence reactance. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

TapChanger.description: Mechanism for changing transformer winding tap positions.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the TapChanger: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

controlEnabled.name: controlEnabled
controlEnabled.description: Specifies the regulation status of the equipment. True is regulating, false is not regulating. Multiplicity 1..1.

highStep.name: highStep
highStep.description: Highest possible tap step position, advance from neutral. The attribute shall be greater than lowStep. Multiplicity 1..1.

lowStep.name: lowStep
lowStep.description: Lowest possible tap step position, retard from neutral. Multiplicity 1..1.

ltcFlag.name: ltcFlag
ltcFlag.description: Specifies whether or not a TapChanger has load tap changing capabilities. Multiplicity 1..1.

neutralStep.name: neutralStep
neutralStep.description: The neutral tap step position for this winding. The attribute shall be equal to or greater than lowStep and equal or less than highStep. It is the step position where the voltage is neutralU when the other terminals of the transformer are at the ratedU. If there are other tap changers on the transformer those taps are kept constant at their neutralStep. Multiplicity 1..1.

neutralU.name: neutralU
neutralU.description: Voltage at which the winding operates at the neutral tap setting. It is the voltage at the terminal of the PowerTransformerEnd associated with the tap changer when all tap changers on the transformer are at their neutralStep position. Normally neutralU of the tap changer is the same as ratedU of the PowerTransformerEnd, but it can differ in special cases such as when the tapping mechanism is separate from the winding more common on lower voltage transformers. This attribute is not relevant for PhaseTapChangerAsymmetrical, PhaseTapChangerSymmetrical and PhaseTapChangerLinear. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

normalStep.name: normalStep
normalStep.description: The tap step position used in "normal" network operation for this winding. For a "Fixed" tap changer indicates the current physical tap setting. The attribute shall be equal to or greater than lowStep and equal to or less than highStep. Multiplicity 1..1.

step.name: step
step.description: Tap changer position. Starting step for a steady state solution. Non integer values are allowed to support continuous tap variables. The reasons for continuous value are to support study cases where no discrete tap changer has yet been designed, a solution where a narrow voltage band forces the tap step to oscillate or to accommodate for a continuous solution as input. The attribute shall be equal to or greater than lowStep and equal to or less than highStep. Multiplicity 1..1.

TapChangerControl.description: Describes behaviour specific to tap changers, e.g. how the voltage at the end of a line varies with the load level and compensation of the voltage drop by tap adjustment.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the TapChangerControl: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

TapChangerTablePoint.description: Describes each tap step in the tabular curve.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the TapChangerTablePoint: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

b.name: b
b.description: The magnetizing branch susceptance deviation as a percentage of nominal value. The actual susceptance is calculated as follows: calculated magnetizing susceptance = b(nominal) * (1 + b(from this class)/100). The b(nominal) is defined as the static magnetizing susceptance on the associated power transformer end or ends. This model assumes the star impedance (pi model) form.

g.name: g
g.description: The magnetizing branch conductance deviation as a percentage of nominal value. The actual conductance is calculated as follows: calculated magnetizing conductance = g(nominal) * (1 + g(from this class)/100). The g(nominal) is defined as the static magnetizing conductance on the associated power transformer end or ends. This model assumes the star impedance (pi model) form.

r.name: r
r.description: The resistance deviation as a percentage of nominal value. The actual reactance is calculated as follows: calculated resistance = r(nominal) * (1 + r(from this class)/100). The r(nominal) is defined as the static resistance on the associated power transformer end or ends. This model assumes the star impedance (pi model) form.

ratio.name: ratio
ratio.description: The voltage at the tap step divided by rated voltage of the transformer end having the tap changer. Hence this is a value close to one. For example, if the ratio at step 1 is 1.01, and the rated voltage of the transformer end is 110kV, then the voltage obtained by setting the tap changer to step 1 to is 111.1kV.

x.name: x
x.description: The series reactance deviation as a percentage of nominal value. The actual reactance is calculated as follows: calculated reactance = x(nominal) * (1 + x(from this class)/100). The x(nominal) is defined as the static series reactance on the associated power transformer end or ends. This model assumes the star impedance (pi model) form.

Terminal.description: An AC electrical connection point to a piece of conducting equipment. Terminals are connected at physical connection points called connectivity nodes.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Terminal: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

phases.name: phases
phases.description: Represents the normal network phasing condition. If the attribute is missing, three phases (ABC) shall be assumed, except for terminals of grounding classes (specializations of EarthFaultCompensator, GroundDisconnector, and Ground) which will be assumed to be N. Therefore, phase code ABCN is explicitly declared when needed, e.g. for star point grounding equipment. The phase code on terminals connecting same ConnectivityNode or same TopologicalNode as well as for equipment between two terminals shall be consistent.

ThermalGeneratingUnit.description: A generating unit whose prime mover could be a steam turbine, combustion turbine, or diesel engine.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the ThermalGeneratingUnit: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

TieFlow.description: Defines the structure (in terms of location and direction) of the net interchange constraint for a control area. This constraint may be used by either AGC or power flow.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the TieFlow: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

positiveFlowIn.name: positiveFlowIn
positiveFlowIn.description: Specifies the sign of the tie flow associated with a control area. True if positive flow into the terminal (load convention) is also positive flow into the control area. See the description of ControlArea for further explanation of how TieFlow.positiveFlowIn is used. Multiplicity 1..1.

TransformerEnd.description: A conducting connection point of a power transformer. It corresponds to a physical transformer winding terminal. In earlier CIM versions, the TransformerWinding class served a similar purpose, but this class is more flexible because it associates to terminal but is not a specialization of ConductingEquipment.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the TransformerEnd: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

endNumber.name: endNumber
endNumber.description: Number for this transformer end, corresponding to the end's order in the power transformer vector group or phase angle clock number. Highest voltage winding should be 1. Each end within a power transformer should have a unique subsequent end number. Note the transformer end number need not match the terminal sequence number. Multiplicity 1..1.

grounded.name: grounded
grounded.description: (for Yn and Zn connections) True if the neutral is solidly grounded. Multiplicity 1..1.

rground.name: rground
rground.description: (for Yn and Zn connections) Resistance part of neutral impedance where 'grounded' is true. CIM type Resistance, in ohm.

xground.name: xground
xground.description: (for Yn and Zn connections) Reactive part of neutral impedance where 'grounded' is true. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

VoltageLevel.description: A collection of equipment at one common system voltage forming a switchgear. The equipment typically consists of breakers, busbars, instrumentation, control, regulation and protection devices as well as assemblies of all these.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the VoltageLevel: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

highVoltageLimit.name: highVoltageLimit
highVoltageLimit.description: The bus bar's high voltage limit. The limit applies to all equipment and nodes contained in a given VoltageLevel. It is not required that it is exchanged in pair with lowVoltageLimit. It is preferable to use operational VoltageLimit, which prevails, if present. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

lowVoltageLimit.name: lowVoltageLimit
lowVoltageLimit.description: The bus bar's low voltage limit. The limit applies to all equipment and nodes contained in a given VoltageLevel. It is not required that it is exchanged in pair with highVoltageLimit. It is preferable to use operational VoltageLimit, which prevails, if present. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

VoltageLimit.description: Operational limit applied to voltage. The use of operational VoltageLimit is preferred instead of limits defined at VoltageLevel. The operational VoltageLimits are used, if present.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the VoltageLimit: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

normalValue.name: normalValue
normalValue.description: The normal limit on voltage. High or low limit nature of the limit depends upon the properties of the operational limit type. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

value.name: value
value.description: Limit on voltage. High or low limit nature of the limit depends upon the properties of the operational limit type. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

VsCapabilityCurve.description: The P-Q capability curve for a voltage source converter, with P on X-axis and Qmin and Qmax on Y1-axis and Y2-axis.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the VsCapabilityCurve: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

VsConverter.description: DC side of the voltage source converter (VSC).

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the VsConverter: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

delta.name: delta
delta.description: Angle between VsConverter.uv and ACDCConverter.uc. It is converter’s state variable used in power flow. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type AngleDegrees, in deg.

droop.name: droop
droop.description: Droop constant. The pu value is obtained as D [kV/MW] x Sb / Ubdc. The attribute shall be a positive value.

droopCompensation.name: droopCompensation
droopCompensation.description: Compensation constant. Used to compensate for voltage drop when controlling voltage at a distant bus. The attribute shall be a positive value. CIM type Resistance, in ohm.

maxModulationIndex.name: maxModulationIndex
maxModulationIndex.description: The maximum quotient between the AC converter voltage (Uc) and DC voltage (Ud). A factor typically less than 1. It is converter’s configuration data used in power flow.

pPccControl.name: pPccControl
pPccControl.description: Kind of control of real power and/or DC voltage. Multiplicity 1..1.

qPccControl.name: qPccControl
qPccControl.description: Kind of reactive power control. Multiplicity 1..1.

qShare.name: qShare
qShare.description: Reactive power sharing factor among parallel converters on Uac control. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

targetPWMfactor.name: targetPWMfactor
targetPWMfactor.description: Magnitude of pulse-modulation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value.

targetPhasePcc.name: targetPhasePcc
targetPhasePcc.description: Phase target at AC side, at point of common coupling. The attribute shall be a positive value. CIM type AngleDegrees, in deg.

targetPowerFactorPcc.name: targetPowerFactorPcc
targetPowerFactorPcc.description: Power factor target at the AC side, at point of common coupling. The attribute shall be a positive value.

targetQpcc.name: targetQpcc
targetQpcc.description: Reactive power injection target in AC grid, at point of common coupling. Load sign convention is used, i.e. positive sign means flow out from a node. CIM type ReactivePower, in MVAr.

targetUpcc.name: targetUpcc
targetUpcc.description: Voltage target in AC grid, at point of common coupling. The attribute shall be a positive value. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

uv.name: uv
uv.description: Line-to-line voltage on the valve side of the converter transformer. It is converter’s state variable, result from power flow. The attribute shall be a positive value. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Voltage, in kV.

WaveTrap.description: Line traps are devices that impede high frequency power line carrier signals yet present a negligible impedance at the main power frequency.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the WaveTrap: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

WindGeneratingUnit.description: A wind driven generating unit, connected to the grid by means of a rotating machine. May be used to represent a single turbine or an aggregation.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the WindGeneratingUnit: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

windGenUnitType.name: windGenUnitType
windGenUnitType.description: The kind of wind generating unit. Multiplicity 1..1.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the WindPowerPlant: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

Accumulator.description: Accumulator represents an accumulated (counted) Measurement, e.g. an energy value.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Accumulator: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the AccumulatorLimit: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

value.name: value
value.description: The value to supervise against. The value is positive. Multiplicity 1..1.

AccumulatorLimitSet.description: An AccumulatorLimitSet specifies a set of Limits that are associated with an Accumulator measurement.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the AccumulatorLimitSet: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

AccumulatorReset.description: This command resets the counter value to zero.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the AccumulatorReset: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the AccumulatorValue: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Analog: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

positiveFlowIn.name: positiveFlowIn
positiveFlowIn.description: If true then this measurement is an active power, reactive power or current with the convention that a positive value measured at the Terminal means power is flowing into the related PowerSystemResource.

AnalogControl.description: An analog control used for supervisory control.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the AnalogControl: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

maxValue.name: maxValue
maxValue.description: Normal value range maximum for any of the Control.value. Used for scaling, e.g. in bar graphs. Multiplicity 1..1.

minValue.name: minValue
minValue.description: Normal value range minimum for any of the Control.value. Used for scaling, e.g. in bar graphs. Multiplicity 1..1.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the AnalogLimit: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

value.name: value
value.description: The value to supervise against. Multiplicity 1..1.

AnalogLimitSet.description: An AnalogLimitSet specifies a set of Limits that are associated with an Analog measurement.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the AnalogLimitSet: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the AnalogValue: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

Command.description: A Command is a discrete control used for supervisory control.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Command: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

normalValue.name: normalValue
normalValue.description: Normal value for Control.value e.g. used for percentage scaling. Multiplicity 1..1.

value.name: value
value.description: The value representing the actuator output. Multiplicity 1..1.

Control.description: Control is used for supervisory/device control. It represents control outputs that are used to change the state in a process, e.g. close or open breaker, a set point value or a raise lower command.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Control: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

controlType.name: controlType
controlType.description: Specifies the type of Control. For example, this specifies if the Control represents BreakerOpen, BreakerClose, GeneratorVoltageSetPoint, GeneratorRaise, GeneratorLower, etc. Multiplicity 1..1.

operationInProgress.name: operationInProgress
operationInProgress.description: Indicates that a client is currently sending control commands that has not completed.

timeStamp.name: timeStamp
timeStamp.description: The last time a control output was sent.

unitMultiplier.name: unitMultiplier
unitMultiplier.description: The unit multiplier of the controlled quantity.

unitSymbol.name: unitSymbol
unitSymbol.description: The unit of measure of the controlled quantity.

Discrete.description: Discrete represents a discrete Measurement, i.e. a Measurement representing discrete values, e.g. a Breaker position.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Discrete: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the DiscreteValue: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

IOPoint.description: The class describe a measurement or control value. The purpose is to enable having attributes and associations common for measurement and control.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the IOPoint: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

Limit.description: Specifies one limit value for a Measurement. A Measurement typically has several limits that are kept together by the LimitSet class. The actual meaning and use of a Limit instance (i.e., if it is an alarm or warning limit or if it is a high or low limit) is not captured in the Limit class. However the name of a Limit instance may indicate both meaning and use.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Limit: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

LimitSet.description: Specifies a set of Limits that are associated with a Measurement. A Measurement may have several LimitSets corresponding to seasonal or other changing conditions. The condition is captured in the name and description attributes. The same LimitSet may be used for several Measurements. In particular percentage limits are used this way.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the LimitSet: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

isPercentageLimits.name: isPercentageLimits
isPercentageLimits.description: Tells if the limit values are in percentage of normalValue or the specified Unit for Measurements and Controls.

Measurement.description: A Measurement represents any measured, calculated or non-measured non-calculated quantity. Any piece of equipment may contain Measurements, e.g. a substation may have temperature measurements and door open indications, a transformer may have oil temperature and tank pressure measurements, a bay may contain a number of power flow measurements and a Breaker may contain a switch status measurement. The PSR - Measurement association is intended to capture this use of Measurement and is included in the naming hierarchy based on EquipmentContainer. The naming hierarchy typically has Measurements as leaves, e.g. Substation-VoltageLevel-Bay-Switch-Measurement. Some Measurements represent quantities related to a particular sensor location in the network, e.g. a voltage transformer (VT) or potential transformer (PT) at a busbar or a current transformer (CT) at the bar between a breaker and an isolator. The sensing position is not captured in the PSR - Measurement association. Instead it is captured by the Measurement…

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Measurement: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

measurementType.name: measurementType
measurementType.description: Specifies the type of measurement. For example, this specifies if the measurement represents an indoor temperature, outdoor temperature, bus voltage, line flow, etc. When the measurementType is set to "Specialization", the type of Measurement is defined in more detail by the specialized class which inherits from Measurement. Multiplicity 1..1.

phases.name: phases
phases.description: Indicates to which phases the measurement applies and avoids the need to use 'measurementType' to also encode phase information (which would explode the types). The phase information in Measurement, along with 'measurementType' and 'phases' uniquely defines a Measurement for a device, based on normal network phase. Their meaning will not change when the computed energizing phasing is changed due to jumpers or other reasons. If the attribute is missing three phases (ABC) shall be assumed.

unitMultiplier.name: unitMultiplier
unitMultiplier.description: The unit multiplier of the measured quantity. Multiplicity 1..1.

unitSymbol.name: unitSymbol
unitSymbol.description: The unit of measure of the measured quantity. Multiplicity 1..1.

MeasurementValue.description: The current state for a measurement. A state value is an instance of a measurement from a specific source. Measurements can be associated with many state values, each representing a different source for the measurement.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the MeasurementValue: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

sensorAccuracy.name: sensorAccuracy
sensorAccuracy.description: The limit, expressed as a percentage of the sensor maximum, that errors will not exceed when the sensor is used under reference conditions.

timeStamp.name: timeStamp
timeStamp.description: The time when the value was last updated.

MeasurementValueQuality.description: Measurement quality flags. Bits 0-10 are defined for substation automation in IEC 61850-7-3. Bits 11-15 are reserved for future expansion by that document. Bits 16-31 are reserved for EMS applications.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the MeasurementValueQuality: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

MeasurementValueSource.description: MeasurementValueSource describes the alternative sources updating a MeasurementValue. User conventions for how to use the MeasurementValueSource attributes are defined in IEC 61970-301.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the MeasurementValueSource: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

Quality61850.description: Quality flags in this class are as defined in IEC 61850, except for estimatorReplaced, which has been included in this class for convenience.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the Quality61850: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

badReference.name: badReference
badReference.description: Measurement value may be incorrect due to a reference being out of calibration.

estimatorReplaced.name: estimatorReplaced
estimatorReplaced.description: Value has been replaced by State Estimator. estimatorReplaced is not an IEC61850 quality bit but has been put in this class for convenience.

failure.name: failure
failure.description: This identifier indicates that a supervision function has detected an internal or external failure, e.g. communication failure.

oldData.name: oldData
oldData.description: Measurement value is old and possibly invalid, as it has not been successfully updated during a specified time interval.

operatorBlocked.name: operatorBlocked
operatorBlocked.description: Measurement value is blocked and hence unavailable for transmission.

oscillatory.name: oscillatory
oscillatory.description: To prevent some overload of the communication it is sensible to detect and suppress oscillating (fast changing) binary inputs. If a signal changes in a defined time twice in the same direction (from 0 to 1 or from 1 to 0) then oscillation is detected and the detail quality identifier "oscillatory" is set. If it is detected a configured numbers of transient changes could be passed by. In this time the validity status "questionable" is set. If after this defined numbers of changes the signal is still in the oscillating state the value shall be set either to the opposite state of the previous stable value or to a defined default value. In this case the validity status "questionable" is reset and "invalid" is set as long as the signal is oscillating. If it is configured such that no transient changes should be passed by then the validity status "invalid" is set immediately in addition to the detail quality identifier "oscillatory" (used for status information only).

outOfRange.name: outOfRange
outOfRange.description: Measurement value is beyond a predefined range of value.

overFlow.name: overFlow
overFlow.description: Measurement value is beyond the capability of being represented properly. For example, a counter value overflows from maximum count back to a value of zero.

source.name: source
source.description: Source gives information related to the origin of a value. The value may be acquired from the process, defaulted or substituted.

suspect.name: suspect
suspect.description: A correlation function has detected that the value is not consistent with other values. Typically set by a network State Estimator.

test.name: test
test.description: Measurement value is transmitted for test purposes.

RaiseLowerCommand.description: An analog control that increases or decreases a set point value with pulses. Unless otherwise specified, one pulse moves the set point by one.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the RaiseLowerCommand: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

SetPoint.description: An analog control that issues a set point value.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the SetPoint: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

normalValue.name: normalValue
normalValue.description: Normal value for Control.value e.g. used for percentage scaling. Multiplicity 1..1.

value.name: value
value.description: The value representing the actuator output. Multiplicity 1..1.

StringMeasurement.description: StringMeasurement represents a measurement with values of type string.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the StringMeasurement: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

StringMeasurementValue.description: StringMeasurementValue represents a measurement value of type string.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the StringMeasurementValue: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

ValueAliasSet.description: Describes the translation of a set of values into a name and is intendend to facilitate custom translations. Each ValueAliasSet has a name, description etc. A specific Measurement may represent a discrete state like Open, Closed, Intermediate etc. This requires a translation from the MeasurementValue.value number to a string, e.g. 0->"Invalid", 1->"Open", 2->"Closed", 3->"Intermediate". Each ValueToAlias member in ValueAliasSet.Value describe a mapping for one particular value to a name.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the ValueAliasSet: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

ValueToAlias.description: Describes the translation of one particular value into a name, e.g. 1 as "Open".

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the ValueToAlias: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

value.name: value
value.description: The value that is mapped. Multiplicity 1..1.

MutualCoupling.description: This class represents the zero sequence line mutual coupling.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the MutualCoupling: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

b0ch.name: b0ch
b0ch.description: Zero sequence mutual coupling shunt (charging) susceptance, uniformly distributed, of the entire line section. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Susceptance, in S.

distance11.name: distance11
distance11.description: Distance to the start of the coupled region from the first line's terminal having sequence number equal to 1. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Length, in km.

distance12.name: distance12
distance12.description: Distance to the end of the coupled region from the first line's terminal with sequence number equal to 1. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Length, in km.

distance21.name: distance21
distance21.description: Distance to the start of coupled region from the second line's terminal with sequence number equal to 1. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Length, in km.

distance22.name: distance22
distance22.description: Distance to the end of coupled region from the second line's terminal with sequence number equal to 1. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Length, in km.

g0ch.name: g0ch
g0ch.description: Zero sequence mutual coupling shunt (charging) conductance, uniformly distributed, of the entire line section. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Conductance, in S.

r0.name: r0
r0.description: Zero sequence branch-to-branch mutual impedance coupling, resistance. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Resistance, in ohm.

x0.name: x0
x0.description: Zero sequence branch-to-branch mutual impedance coupling, reactance. Multiplicity 1..1. CIM type Reactance, in ohm.

rdfId.name: rdfId
rdfId.description: The identifier of the DCTopologicalNode: the rdf:ID of its element in a CGMES (CIMXML) file, or the rdf:about, without its leading #, of the elements that describe it in other profiles. For an IdentifiedObject it is derived from its mRID.

TopologicalNode.description: For a detailed substation model a topological node is a set of connectivity nodes that, in the current network state, are connected together through any type of closed switches, including jumpers. Topological nodes change as the current network state changes (i.e., switches, breakers, etc. change state). For a planning model, switch statuses are not used to form topological nodes.
